Barkley was a power forward who loved to rebound and use his strength to bully defenders.

Cunningham is a floor general who manipulates the game on both ends with his scoring and IQ.

Two completely different job descriptions but both provide the same level of impact.

Today’s full NFL memo, clarifying that Zxavian Harris and Dae’Quan Wright are barred from visiting, trying out with or being signed by NFL clubs during the 2026 NFL season.

The NFL noted in the memo that this list is not inclusive of all 2026 draft-eligible players who returned to college and directed questions about other players to the league’s management council. 

“Clubs are reminded that it is each club's responsibility to verify player eligibility. If a club is unable to verify a player's eligibility, either on its own or in consultation with the NFL Player Personnel Department, the club may not sign such player to a contract and may not otherwise permit the player to practice or play with the club (including a visit or tryout). Violations may subject the club to discipline, including the loss of draft choices and/or fines, and club personnel may also be subject to fines and/or suspension. If there is any question regarding a player's NFL eligibility, it is imperative that the club contact the NFL Player Personnel Department.”

After various court, SEC and NCAA developments, LSU ultimately did not add Harris or Wright to their 105-man roster. They are now without a place to play in 2026; they have already been draft-eligible, so they'll be free agents after the season.
